title: Map: notebook RBAC actions and where they're enforced
answers: Where are notebook permissions checked in the frontend?
What file defines the notebooks RBAC actions?
body: Notebooks have their own four RBAC actions (notebooks:create/read/write/delete) defined in public/app/types/accessControl.ts (AccessControlAction.NotebooksCreate/Read/Write/Delete), independent of dashboards:* actions. Frontend org-level checks live in public/app/features/notebook/permissions.ts (canCreateNotebooks/canEditNotebooks/canDeleteNotebooks/canAddPanelToNotebook); the mutation-API layer has its own parallel checks in public/app/features/notebook/mutation-api/commands/permissions.ts (requiresNotebookRead/Edit/Create). Routes are gated in public/app/routes/routes.tsx, and the nav entry in public/app/core/navtree/sections/notebooks.navEntry.ts. All of these are org-level (no per-notebook scope); the backend verb-to-action mapping they must match is in pkg/registry/apis/folders/sub_access.go:160-165. Note: notebooks:create is granted via a folders:* scope rather than notebooks:*, but hasPermission ignores scope so the check still works.
applies: Any future change to notebook RBAC behavior or adding a new notebook action
